elements.element: Vendor owes a defence obligation to Customer
elements.evidence: TrueLink shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Client

elements.element: Indemnity runs to Customer and its affiliates
elements.evidence: Client and its affiliates, directors, officers, employees and agents

elements.evidence: an allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any deliverable provided by TrueLink infringes or misappropriates any copyright, trade secret, trademark, patent or other intellectual property right

elements.element: Covers claims arising from Vendor's breach of law
elements.evidence: TrueLink's violation of any applicable law, rule or regulation

elements.element: Covers data breach caused by Vendor
elements.evidence: any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or Client Confidential Information caused by TrueLink

elements.element: Covers Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct
shall give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of the claim
tender sole control of the defense and settlement
provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying party's expense

elements.element: Customer's indemnity limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law
elements.evidence: Clause a. left intact: "Client shall indemnify and hold TrueLink ... harmless from and against all claims, actions, expenses, losses, and liabilities ... arising from or relating to the following:" — no limitation to Client content and Client breach of law was inserted
an allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any deliverable ... infringes or misappropriates any ... intellectual property right
No modification exclusion appears in the inserted clause c.
No combination exclusion in operative text (only mentioned in the non-operative margin comment)
No specifications exclusion in clause c.

elements.element: Infringement remedies: procure, modify, replace, refund
elements.evidence: Clause c. contains no procure/modify/replace/refund remedy language

elements.element: Vendor indemnity subject to super-cap of 3x annual fees
elements.evidence: No cap or super-cap language inserted

offending_extra_words: provided that no settlement imposing liability or admission on the indemnified party shall be made without its consent
reasons: Preferred level is incomplete: the pre-existing broad Client indemnity in clause a. was left untouched, so the required limitation of Customer's indemnity to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law is absent.

Fallback level is also not satisfied on its own terms (no modification/combination/specification exclusions, no procure-modify-replace-refund remedies, no 3x annual fees super-cap); the exclusions appear only in the non-operative margin comment.

Minimality fails: the insertion adds hold-harmless language, indemnitees beyond Customer and affiliates (directors, officers, employees, agents), and settlement-consent mechanics beyond the notice/control/cooperation procedure called for by the preferred prose.

Intent is otherwise preserved: the redline is an additive clause c. that leaves all other paragraphs operative, though it relies on terms (Interface, Support Services, Client Content, Client Confidential Information) that must be defined elsewhere in the Agreement.
